question: A customer reports Fibre Channel login requests to a Cisco MDS 9000 Series switch from an authorized source. The customer requires a feature that will allow all devices already logged in and learned to be added to the Fibre Channel active database. Which two features must be enabled to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)
theory: Cisco MDS auto-learning port security captures the WWNs of devices that are already logged in to a switch at the time the feature is enabled, as well as new devices that log in afterward, and adds them automatically to the port-security active database without requiring manual entry. Simply enabling the port-security feature and activating it on the relevant VSAN triggers auto-learning by default, satisfying the requirement to admit already-authorized, already-logged-in devices with no extra configuration. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - Port Security, Auto-Learning)
